title: Brand Reputation and Word of Mouth in the Digital Age
summary: ORANGE-L2-037: Brand Reputation and Word of Mouth in the Digital Age.
body: This ORANGE Level 2 lesson develops practical sales and marketing competency in Brand Reputation and Word of Mouth in the Digital Age. Learners should connect the concept to customer behaviour, positioning, acquisition economics, conversion, retention and measurable business outcomes. The objective is to make evidence-based marketing and sales decisions, distinguish useful metrics from vanity metrics, and apply ethical persuasion without manipulation. Examples should be adapted to the relevant market, customer segment and regulatory environment.
